description: This PHP script is part of the SuiteCRM upgrade wizard, handling the upload phase of upgrade packages. It manages file uploads, validation, extraction, and preparation for installation, including security checks, logging, and user interface components for the web-based upgrade process.

classes.name: UploadFile
classes.description: A class handling file upload operations, including validation, moving, and managing uploaded files.

classes.name: PackageManager
classes.description: A class for managing package downloads and setup during the upgrade process.

classes.name: ModuleScanner
classes.description: A class for scanning and analyzing module files in the manifest during upgrade validation.

methods.name: confirm_upload
methods.description: Confirms whether the uploaded file is valid and successfully received.

methods.name: get_stored_file_name
methods.description: Returns the filename stored temporarily after upload.

methods.name: final_move
methods.description: Moves the uploaded file to the final destination on the server.

methods.name: get_upload_error
methods.description: Retrieves any upload errors encountered during the upload process.
